source16-audit.description: Audit metadata and Vietnamese subtitle/caption availability for the 16 locked MayMay source videos.

source16-captions.description: Download and parse Vietnamese automatic captions for all 16 MayMay source videos; build sentence-safe ~50k-character review packs.

source16-whisper-consensus-pilot.description: Pilot one locked source with Faster-Whisper large-v3, word timestamps, YouTube-caption consensus, and pause timing features.

source16-whisper-consensus.description: Run Faster-Whisper large-v3 across all 16 locked sources using private YouTube cookies; export text consensus and word timing features.

source16-segmentation.description: Build a CPU-only TTS cut plan from the durable Source16 Whisper checkpoint plus staged source media; no audio is cut in this stage.

source16-cut-pilot.description: Cut the QC-selected 160-clip Source16 listening pilot on Kaggle CPU; verify each WAV duration before any bulk slicing.

source16-keep-auto-cut-pilot.description: Cut a 160-row KEEP_AUTO-only Source16 pilot to final training format: mono PCM16 WAV at 22050 Hz, with duration/sample-rate/channel verification.
